scenes.say: Ever wonder how machine learning models actually get built, shipped, and kept running in production? Let’s break down the ML lifecycle and see where MLOps fits in.
Here’s the typical flow: collect data, process it into features, train your model, evaluate how well it works, deploy it, and keep an eye on it once it’s live.

scenes.label: MLOps
scenes.sub: Automates and connects every ML stage
scenes.say: MLOps is all about automating and connecting these stages. It brings DevOps ideas to machine learning, so teams can collaborate and ship models faster and more reliably.
Think of MLOps as the bridge between data science and production. It makes sure models aren’t just built, but actually deployed and maintained at scale.

scenes.question: Is MLOps just about deployment?
scenes.right: No, MLOps covers the whole ML lifecycle: from data to monitoring.
scenes.say: Watch out: MLOps isn’t just about deployment. It covers every stage, from data to monitoring, making the whole process repeatable and robust.
